title: ADIF Canonical Data Model v1.0 (apparel)
description: Vendor-neutral canonical schema for apparel Digital Product Passports. Derived from ESPR (EU) 2024/1781 Annex III paragraph 1 points (a)-(k), expanded through Article 7(5) and Article 5(1) where point (a) refers out, plus Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 for fibre composition and the ADID identity dimensions. Each field carries its source clause in x-adif. EPCIS 2.0 event attributes and UNTP credential semantics are NOT yet incorporated - see cdm/EXTRACTION.md.

productFamily.description: product family or design name shared across all colour and size variants

x-adif.note: NO regulatory source. ESPR Art 9(2)(d) requires delegated acts to state whether a passport sits at model, batch or item level, but neither ESPR nor GS1 provides a family-level identifier. Supplying one is ADID's contribution, not a restatement of an existing standard.

passportGranularity.description: level at which this passport is established: model, batch or item

x-adif.note: Point (b) says the identifier is 'at the level indicated in the applicable delegated act'. Maps to ADID family/variant/instance. SYSTEM-ASSIGNED, not mapped from manufacturer input: ADID sets it from the level of the identifier it issues (family/variant/instance). Excluded from the mandatory input set for that reason.

productIdentifier.description: unique product identifier at the level set by the applicable delegated act

gtin.description: Global Trade Item Number of the product or its parts, per ISO/IEC 15459-6 or equivalent

x-adif.note: A GTIN identifies one colour-and-size combination. It sits at variant level and can never represent a family (decisions.md D9).

commodityCode.description: relevant commodity code, such as a TARIC code

complianceDocumentation.description: compliance documentation required under this Regulation or other Union law

declarationOfConformity.description: declaration of conformity reference or document link

conformityCertificate.description: conformity certificate reference or document link

userManual.description: user manual or instructions for use

safetyInformation.description: warnings or safety information required by other applicable Union law

careInstructions.description: care, washing and maintenance instructions for the garment

x-adif.note: Apparel-specific reading of point (f): care labelling is the garment sector's instructions-for-use.

manufacturerOperatorId.description: unique operator identifier of the manufacturer

otherOperatorIdentifiers.description: unique operator identifiers other than that of the manufacturer

facilityIdentifiers.description: unique facility identifiers for locations or buildings in the value chain

importerEori.description: Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number of the importer

euResponsibleName.description: name of the economic operator established in the Union responsible for market surveillance tasks

euResponsibleContact.description: contact details of the responsible Union-established economic operator

euResponsibleOperatorId.description: unique operator identifier of the responsible Union-established economic operator

substanceIupacName.description: IUPAC name of a substance of concern present in the product

substanceOtherNames.description: other names of the substance of concern, including trade names

substanceEcNumber.description: EC number of the substance of concern

substanceCasNumber.description: CAS name and number of the substance of concern

substanceLocation.description: location of the substance of concern within the product

substanceConcentration.description: concentration or concentration range of the substance of concern

substanceSafeUse.description: instructions for safe use of the product

substanceEndOfLife.description: end-of-life information for disassembly, reuse or recycling

reparability.description: reparability of the product, such as a repairability score

recycledContent.description: recycled content of the product, as a percentage

carbonFootprint.description: carbon footprint in kilograms of CO2 equivalent

expectedWasteGeneration.description: expected generation of waste material from the product

fibreComposition.description: fibre composition of the textile product by percentage of weight

x-adif.note: Apparel-sector mandatory labelling. Required independently of ESPR; the textile delegated act is not yet adopted, so this is the firmest available basis for composition data.

size.description: size designation of the garment variant

countryOfOrigin.description: country of manufacture, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

batchNumber.description: batch or lot number of the production run

x-adif.note: Introduces BATCH granularity, which ESPR Art 9(2)(d) names (model/batch/item) but ADID's three levels do not carry. See the alignment note in cdm/ALIGNMENT.md — this is a real gap, not an oversight.

serialNumber.description: serial number identifying one physical unit

x-adif.note: GTIN + serial = SGTIN = ADID instance level.

x-adif.clause: DPP credentialSubject.productionDate; EPCIS eventTime at commissioning

productCategory.description: product classification, such as a UN-CPC or similar scheme code

netWeight.description: net weight of the product, with UNECE unit

materialOriginCountry.description: country of origin of a constituent material, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

x-adif.note: Distinct from countryOfOrigin, which is where the GARMENT was made. Fabric is routinely woven in one country and sewn in another — collapsing the two would misstate the supply chain.

materialMassFraction.description: mass fraction of a constituent material in the product

emissionsDeclaredUnit.description: declared unit the carbon footprint figure is expressed per

x-adif.note: A carbon figure without its declared unit is uninterpretable: 4.2 kg CO2e per garment and per kilogram are different claims.

emissionsReportingStandard.description: standard under which the emissions figure was calculated

conformityClaim.description: claim of conformity against a named standard or regulation

x-adif.note: UNTP's verification layer. Where ESPR Annex III 1(e) asks WHETHER compliance documentation exists, UNTP structures WHAT is claimed and who attests it.

dueDiligenceDeclaration.description: link to the supply chain due diligence declaration

productionFacilityLocation.description: business location where production took place

x-adif.note: Complements ESPR Annex III 1(i): the ESPR point mandates a facility IDENTIFIER, EPCIS supplies the location semantics around it.

productionStage.description: business process step the product has completed

disposition.description: business state of the product, such as in_transit or sellable

purchaseOrderReference.description: business transaction reference, such as a purchase order number
